coexistence.interpretation: Observed same-car coexistence: openpilot lateral is active through C7 while openpilot longActive remains false and Toyota adaptive cruise remains enabled. Toyota lateral request/result IDs stay 0 throughout openpilot latActive, while Toyota longitudinal request/result IDs are active. This separates openpilot lateral authority from factory LTA while retaining stock DRCC longitudinal control.

conclusion: Route 0000010c--506d7277c7 is the first retained exact-Camry road qualification that combines the post-auth functional-C7 EPS-resident lateral path with recovered stock adaptive cruise in the same ignition cycle after the Brake-then-FRC reset sequence. Across 13 lateral-active episodes, openpilot steered for 919.594 s and 19.772 km while stock adaptive cruise overlapped for 919.572 s; openpilot longActive remained false. Factory lateral request/result IDs remained 0 during openpilot lateral control, active C7 target and measured steering correlate at r=0.9939 with 0.505 deg MAE at a tested 260 ms lag, sequence continuity is perfect within active runs, and no permanent steering fault occurred.
